item.title: Taylor Fresh Foods Inc: Spicy Guacamole. Recall
item.summary: Potential contamination with Salmonella. Product details: Spicy Guacamole. Ingredients: Guacamole, Pico De Gallo. Spec Sheet: Guacamole (Avocado, Pico De Gallo, Serrano Peper, Lime Juice, Salt, Pepper); Pico De Gallo (Cilantro, Jalapeno Pepper, Tomato, Yellow Onion) Net Wt: 13 oz. Keep Refrigerated. Distributed By: T...
item.affectedPeople: Domestic: AL, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NE, NH, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, VT, WI, WV. Foreign: Not applicable.
item.remedy: Affected quantity: Tennessee: 5 units; Texas: 360 units
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
